messages:
alex: Quick sync — staging -> customer-vpc bridge for BlackBox private rollout. We have a tentative cutover window next Tue 03:00 UTC. Need clear owners for: L4 firewall rules, egress proxy cert rotation, on‑prem edge box config, and a tested rollback path. Who can own which piece?

mira: I can own the firewall rules (mira). Need final CIDR ranges and port list from infra to write ACLs.

sam: I can take egress proxy/certs. FYI the proxy certs expire 2026-06-10; rotating will need ~2h maintenance. Thereʼs also an MTU mismatch reported on their L3 box — ticket INT-4012 opened.

jordan: Iʼll own the edge box install + airgap packaging. Will prepare signed images and a staging mirror. Question for security: are we allowed to provide the artifact mirror with short-lived tokens?

sasha: Security ok on image signing — use our AQK key. Iʼll add the acceptance checklist (AS-987) and validate HSM/KMS access for their infra team. We should also require signed manifest verification on install.

ops-bot: Reminder — post-cutover smoke script: `./scripts/staging-smoke.sh` will upload results to s3://redwood-smoke/blackbox/. Set a 15m timeout.

alex: Nice. Drafting dependencies + rollback quick reference inline so we have a shared artifact to copy into the runbook: 

```
Dependencies:
- Final CIDR and NAT/public IPs from infra (item: INFRA-523)
- Egress proxy cert rotation plan (owner: sam)
- Signed airgap images + manifest (owner: jordan + sasha)
- Firewall ACLs and ACL reviewer (owner: mira)
- Ops smoke runner credentials + s3 write access

Rollback steps (fast rollback):
1) Revert BGP/route changes on customer edge (their operator)
2) Restore previous firewall ACLs from snapshot (mira)
3) Repoint ingress to staging LB / staging-route (ops)
4) Invalidate new certs and restore previous proxy config (sam)
5) Run quick smoke: `./scripts/staging-smoke.sh --smoke-level basic` and verify endpoints returning 200

Postmortem gating: collect logs from edge box (/var/log/redwood/edge.log), proxy logs, and iptables-save output.
```

sam: I will confirm MTU fix and can prepare a cert-rotation playbook. Question: do we have automated cert rollback if new certs fail? If not, I suggest we keep previous cert on standby and a DNS TTL change as fallback.

mira: Requesting final CIDR list by EOD Friday — I can start drafting ACLs once I have that. Will also attach a pre/post snapshot script to the runbook.

jordan: Staging mirror plan: I'll push images to internal mirror `mirror.redwood.local/blackbox/` and provide sha256 sums. Test install steps for airgap: 
```
# on staging mirror host
mkdir -p /opt/airgap && tar -xzf blackbox-images.tar.gz -C /opt/airgap
sha256sum /opt/airgap/* > /opt/airgap/SHA256SUMS
./install.sh --verify-manifest /opt/airgap/manifest.json
```

sasha: Security note: make sure manifest verification enforces signature and checks image digest. I'll add the verification command to AS-987. Also need confirmation from customer security on HSM access model.

alex: Ownership summary (locking in): firewall = mira, egress proxy = sam, edge image + install = jordan, security/gating = sasha, runbook + rollout coordinator = alex. Iʼll update the runbook (RUNBOOK-BB-01) and add the dependency checklist.

mira: ack, will add ACL templates and snapshot hook.

sam: ack — will post cert-rotation playbook and fallback steps by Mon noon UTC.

jordan: ack — pushing mirror and smoke test on Mon eve, will post SHAs here.

sasha: ack — drafting AS-987 changes and sending to customer sec for sign-off.

alex: Next async check-in Mon 15:00 UTC. If any critical blockers before then, ping #eng-oncall and tag @alex in thread. :eyes: :shipit:

ops-bot: Scheduled reminder set: check-in Monday 15:00 UTC (channel: eng-platform).
